description: List the Switch Styles you can use for your edits, the short codes for editing a talking video (O Openers, W Words, F Frames, R Receipts, B Beats, U App Moments, K Kicks, P Pace, A Audio, G Grade): each code with its group, name, one line, when to use it, the prompt line to paste and its demo clip links, plus the link to the style browser. Filter by group, by who is on camera, or by words. Free, read-only.

group.description: A group letter, for example O for Openers or G for Grade.

query.description: Words to search the names, lines and uses.

talent.description: Who is on camera in the demo, for example Sonia or Milo.
